title: 开始阅读最后更新：2021-05-28 10:07:56 最新章节：奉天七六九 下
lines: 天雷轰隆隆震的远方山脊在颤抖，闪电好似要将大地撕裂，黑压压的滚滚乌云好似就在头顶，天威笼罩之下，人，是那么渺小而脆弱的生物！
血流成河，到处都是尸体，喊杀声在隆隆雷声中，好似已经微不可闻。
皇甫晖满身鲜血，在几名亲兵的护卫下，跌跌撞撞的行走在石林中。
山石嶙峋，又好似迷宫，狂风暴雨中，不辨东西。
“都护公，前方有路！”一名亲兵突然欢呼起来，雨好似也渐渐止歇，前方，隐隐可以看见一个巨大的土丘。
皇甫晖心里长长叹口气，更想放声大笑，只是在几名亲兵面前，尚要保持威仪，只是思及国事之艰难，心头沉重无比，难道，郭荣才是天命所归？周才是大统所在？
皇甫晖为南唐奉化军节度使。
上个月，周主郭荣，统帅大军伐唐，兵锋直指寿州。
而现今唐正是鼎盛之时，有三十六州，江南江北富裕之地，皆为唐之领土。
北方士人多流落至此，所谓“儒衣书服盛于南唐”，“文物有元和之风”。
在乱世之中，南唐已经是最为安稳富饶之所。
是以，虎视眈眈的北境之周国终于伸出了獠牙。
周兵极为骁勇善战，又有许多能征惯战的将帅，南唐羸弱之兵，第一次和周兵作战，刚刚接触便吃了大亏。
皇甫晖率兵来解寿州之围，却被周之悍将赵匡胤杀得落花流水，全军溃败。
远方，还有隐隐的征伐杀声，惨烈的战争，不知道又在双方哪位统帅指挥下展开。
“都护公，你看？！”亲兵们突然绝望的大喊。
此时也爬到了土丘上的皇甫晖，望着土丘远方，立时心里倒吸口冷气，更绝望到了极点。
却见数百步外，一队队黑压压的骑兵正沿着驿道奔驰，显然正是要去驰援战场。
骑兵中军，大大的麾盖后，飘扬着武威飞旗，那无数飘扬的旗帜，好似汇聚成无边无际的阴影，向南唐之境乌压压席卷。
竟然，竟然是周之国主郭荣？！
早传闻这个郭荣天纵神武，亲征从无败绩。
这，这可如何是好？
“天要亡我！”皇甫晖如赘冰窟，
猛地拔出佩剑，皇甫晖便要自刎，落在周军手中受苦，却不如自裁全了名节。
“都护公不可！”左右亲兵急忙拉住他。
突然又有一名亲兵大喊，“咦，那是什么？！”
却见土丘远方，一个黑点由远及近奔驰而来，却是一人一马，双手舞铁槊，猛地便冲进了周军阵中，立时喊杀声大作，枣红马所到，周军骑兵立时哗乱。
“是什么人？”皇甫晖目瞪口呆，一个人，杀进郭荣的禁卫骑兵阵中？是疯了么？
“是，是团结兵？！”皇甫晖身侧亲兵也是瞠目结舌。
那骑士，身着布衣，但头上绑的灰布条甚为醒目，可不正是本国为抗周招募的团结兵？
所谓团结兵，便是农户，此次抗周，江北之地，三户抽一丁，组成团结军。
但基本上，这些乡兵到战场上就是炮灰。
怎么，会有团结兵如此悍勇？
惨叫声中，周军被那骑士铁槊或砸或刺，乱作一团，骑士又突然策马飞奔而出，向远方驶去。
周军训练极为有素，立时便有一支小队骑兵，有百余骑追杀过来。
而那骑士边奔驰，便突然扯下背背的长弓，就见他弓似满月，箭矢闪电般射出，短短一瞬间，一片箭雨就向周军麾盖方向激射而去，动作快的，根本让人看不清。
皇甫晖第一个念头，好快的动作，这一瞬，怕有十几箭了吧？
第二个念头，这弓矢，能射这么远吗？此时骑士离那周军中军麾盖，足足有四五百步远。
content_en:
The distant mountain ridges were trembling with thunder and lightning, the lightning seemed to tear the earth apart, and the rolling black clouds seemed to be right above our heads. Under the might of heaven, humans are such small and fragile creatures!
Rivers of blood flowed, corpses were everywhere, and the cries of death seemed to be inaudible amidst the rumbling thunder.
Huangfu Hui, covered in blood, stumbled through the stone forest under the protection of several soldiers.
The mountains are rugged and rocky, and they are like a maze. In the violent storm, it is difficult to distinguish things.
"Master Protector, there is a road ahead!" A soldier suddenly cheered. The rain seemed to have stopped gradually. A huge mound could be faintly seen ahead.
Huangfuhui sighed deeply in his heart and wanted to laugh loudly. However, he still had to maintain his dignity in front of a few soldiers. However, thinking about the difficulties of the country's affairs, his heart was extremely heavy. Could it be that Guo Rong was the destiny?周才是大统所在？
Huangfuhui was the military governor of Fenghua Army in the Southern Tang Dynasty.
Last month, Guo Rong, the Lord of Zhou, led an army to attack Tang Dynasty, and his troops were directed towards Shouzhou.
Nowadays, the Tang Dynasty is at its peak. There are thirty-six states, and the wealthy places south and north of the Yangtze River are all the territory of the Tang Dynasty.
Many scholars from the north settled here. It is said that "Confucian clothes and scholarly clothes flourished in the Southern Tang Dynasty" and "the cultural relics have the style of Yuanhe".
In troubled times, Southern Tang was already the most stable and prosperous place.
Therefore, the Zhou Kingdom in the north, which was eyeing the enemy, finally stretched out its fangs.
The Zhou soldiers were extremely brave and good at fighting, and they had many generals who were accustomed to fighting. However, the weak soldiers of the Southern Tang Dynasty fought against the Zhou soldiers for the first time, and they suffered heavy losses just after the contact.
Huangfu Hui led his troops to relieve the siege of Shouzhou, but was killed by Zhao Kuangyin, the fierce general of Zhou Dynasty, and the whole army was defeated.
In the distance, there are faint sounds of conquest and killing, and the fierce war is unfolding under the command of which commander on both sides is unknown.
"Master Protector, look?!" the soldiers suddenly shouted in despair.
Huangfu Hui, who had also climbed onto the mound at this time, looked at the distance of the mound, and immediately took a breath of air and became even more desperate.
But hundreds of steps away, groups of dark cavalry were seen galloping along the post road, obviously going to rush to support the battlefield.
The cavalry squadron, behind their large banners, fluttered the mighty flying flags. The countless fluttering flags seemed to have gathered into an endless shadow, sweeping toward the Southern Tang Dynasty.
It turned out to be Guo Rong, the leader of Zhou Dynasty? !
It has been rumored for a long time that this Guo Rongtian is a master of martial arts and has never failed in his personal campaigns.
This, what should we do?
"Heaven is going to kill me!" Huangfu Hui was like an ice cave,
Pulling out his sword suddenly, Huangfu Hui was about to kill himself. He would suffer in the hands of the Zhou army, but it would be better to commit suicide and lose his reputation.
"No, Lord Protector!" The soldiers on the left and right hurriedly grabbed him.
Suddenly another soldier shouted, "Hey, what is that?!"
But in the distance of the mound, a black spot galloped from far to near. It was a man and a horse, dancing with iron swords with both hands. He suddenly rushed into the Zhou army's formation, and there was a loud killing cry. When the bay red horse arrived, the Zhou army's cavalry immediately broke into chaos.
"Who is he?" Huangfu Hui was stunned. He rushed into Guo Rong's cavalry formation alone?是疯了么？
"Yes, it's the United Army?!" The soldiers beside Huangfu Hui were also dumbfounded.
The knight was dressed in civilian clothes, but the gray cloth strip tied on his head was very eye-catching. Could it be that he was a united soldier recruited by his country to fight against the Zhou Dynasty?
The so-called united soldiers are farmers. During this time of fighting against the Zhou Dynasty, in the Jiangbei area, three households were selected to form a united army.
But basically, these country soldiers are just cannon fodder on the battlefield.
How come there are united soldiers who are so brave?
Amidst the screams, the Zhou army was smashed or stabbed by the knight's iron spear, and became a mess. The knight suddenly galloped out on his horse and drove away into the distance.
The Zhou army was extremely well-trained, and immediately there was a small group of cavalry with more than a hundred cavalry chasing them.
While the knight was running, he suddenly pulled off the long bow on his back. His bow was like a full moon, and arrows shot out like lightning. In just a short moment, a shower of arrows shot towards the direction of Zhou Jun's command. His movements were so fast that no one could see clearly.
Huangfu Hui's first thought was that he was moving so fast. In this moment, there were probably more than a dozen arrows, right?
The second thought is, can this bow and arrow shoot so far? At this time, the knight was four to five hundred steps away from the headquarters of the Zhou army.
